union Expression is
    NUMBER(text: string)
    OPERATION(symbol: string, left: Expression, right: Expression)

let operators = ["^", "*", "/", "+", "-"]

precedence(symbol: string) -> int =>
    case symbol
    when "^" then 4
    when "*", "/" then 3
    else 2
    esac

right_associative(symbol: string) -> bool => symbol =~ "^"

needs_parentheses(child: Expression, parent: string,
                  on_right: bool) -> bool
=>
    case child
    when value: Expression.NUMBER then false
    when inner: Expression.OPERATION then (
        let mine = precedence(inner.symbol)
        let theirs = precedence(parent)

        mine < theirs \/
            (mine == theirs /\ on_right != right_associative(parent))
    )
    esac

render(node: Expression) -> string =>
    case node
    when value: Expression.NUMBER then value.text
    when operation: Expression.OPERATION then
        "{part(operation.left, operation.symbol, false)} "
        "{operation.symbol} "
        "{part(operation.right, operation.symbol, true)}"
    esac

part(child: Expression, parent: string, on_right: bool) -> string =>
    if needs_parentheses(child, parent, on_right) then
        "( {render(child)} )"
    else
        render(child)
    fi

convert(source: string) is
    let stack = LIST[Expression]()

    write_line("input: {source}")
    write_line("  {"token",-6}stack")

    for token in source.split([' ']) do
        if operators |> any(symbol => symbol =~ token) then
            let right = stack[stack.count - 1]
            let left = stack[stack.count - 2]

            stack.remove_at(stack.count - 1)
            stack.remove_at(stack.count - 1)

            stack.add(Expression.OPERATION(token, left, right))
        else
            stack.add(Expression.NUMBER(token))
        fi

        write_line("  {token,-6}{stack |> map(render) |> join(" ; ")}")
    od

    write_line("  infix: {render(stack[0])}")
    write_line()

["3 4 2 * 1 5 - 2 3 ^ ^ / +", "1 2 + 3 4 + ^ 5 6 + ^"] |> each(convert)
